options.name: Governed GPT API Gateway
options.why: Manual packets are already transport-neutral; an operator-authorized gateway could reduce friction without redesigning RC5.
options.activation_gate: real operator-pilot evidence that manual consultation packets are useful, bounded, and worth automating

options.name: Long-Horizon Developmental Project Management
options.why: Useful after RC5 proves it can identify deficits and manage improvements across sessions.
options.activation_gate: stable RC5 developmental cycles under real operator use

options.name: Multi-Specialist Governed Cognition
options.why: Could improve advice quality by routing consultation packets to specialist roles, but increases governance complexity.
options.activation_gate: gateway and project-management controls proven first

recommendation: Complete RC5 real operator pilot first. If manual consultation proves useful, design a governed GPT API gateway as an infrastructure transport change, not as autonomous development.
